notes.title: "Card Quest" "Path of Self-Renewal" update is ready to launch!
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!
This is your Card Ques frontline reporter~ Thank you all for your continued support and love. Our card game has been officially launched on Steam and other platforms for over a month. During this time, we have been constantly gathering feedback from adventurers, whether it's about gameplay experience, visual feelings, or in-game characters.
We have not only fixed the bugs encountered during the gameplay but also started a race against time to schedule and produce version 2.0. We have named the new version "Path of Self-Renewal" (Note - Path of Self-Renewal: It signifies self-improvement and starting anew). Let's take a look at the upcoming updates with the frontline reporter. The game 2.0 version will be updated on December 18th (Beijing time).

〓NO.1: Known BUG Issues〓
 Regarding bugs, we will definitely feedback to our technical team as soon as we see them on any platform for investigation and repair. All known bugs encountered by adventurers are being actively addressed, in addition to those already fixed. If you have any questions or feedback about the gaming experience, you can leave a message in the comment section of the platform.

〓NO.2: All Six Characters Online〓 
In this update: Silver Knight - Night, Order Mage - Maria, Night Guardian - Peng Peng, will all be launched at the same time; this is the first time that Bracket Boy, Headmaster, and Card Maze T0 are meeting you adventurers, please be kind and give us your guidance~

〓NO.3: Level Mode Experience Update〓 
Based on the feedback we received about the chapter gameplay, the guidance and progressive relationship in this update will be more apparent, allowing both new and old adventurers to have a smoother experience, with new gameplay and content added as the level increases within the chapter. At the same time, we have made other optimizations; once you clear all the content of the first level of Chapter 1, you will unlock not only the second level of Chapter 1 but also the first level of Chapter 2.

〓NO.4: Brand New UI Interface〓 
The main UI and character UI display have undergone significant changes. The main UI has become more concise and easy to operate, with increased interactivity, such as being able to use the mouse or keyboard to control the display and closure of various icons, and when viewing character skills, you can click on the skill name to see a detailed description, etc. The character UI has been redesigned and added according to the characteristics of each cat, with each cat having its own little world when idle. You can see different scenes by switching characters on the main interface. No matter the wind or rain, the cats are waiting for you in "Card Ques"!!!

〓NO.5: Other Content Updates〓 
In addition to the new content mentioned above, we have also made some optimizations for a better gaming experience since the launch, and the development team is ready to listen!
(1)Optimization of the beginner's guide; we will continue to listen to the feedback from adventurers, and we welcome your feedback! 
(2)Equipment wearing: can be done by right-clicking the mouse or clicking to wear on the equipment page. 
(3) Monster Meow skill viewing: by placing the mouse over the special (skill) icon on the Monster Meow card, you can view its detailed information.

〓NO.6: Future Update Plans〓 
The first priority will still be to address any bugs or issues encountered during the gameplay; we will also update the addition of all levels of Chapter 3 and other content in the future. For more detailed information, please continue to follow our official announcements and sections.

Hello fellow adventurers~
In order to give you a better gaming experience, we have reduced the gold coin consumption. The character unlocking cost has been changed from 1000 gold coins to 100 gold coins, and the treasure chest extraction cost has been changed from 300 gold coins to 100 gold coins.

notes.title: High-strategy adventure game "CARD QUEST"is about to go on sale
notes.content:
The gate to the world of wonder is about to open, are you ready to embrace the adventure?
As night falls, Eileen grips her staff tightly, raising her head and gazing resolutely at the increasingly nightmarish scene. Legend has it that only when adventurers arrive in this world can the sealed portal be activated, and lately, it has been flickering with light and emitting a deep vibration.
Suddenly, the portal burst into a dazzling light, and the adventurer slowly steps out...

Adventurers, the wait is over~ "CARD QUEST" is finally launching! We will officially meet everyone at 3:00 PM today! Thank you for your patient wait and support for the project. The content released this time is the standard version, and we will add new characters and chapter levels, as well as new levels later~ Stay tuned!

❤ "CARD QUEST" Official Launch Content as follows:
1. "CARD QUEST" is offered at a 10% discount for the initial price of , and the discounted price will last for 14 days; don't miss it as you pass by~

2. New character debut! Miracle Archer - Aller
Aller: The big brother from the orphanage, who has always taken care of Ace and Eileen, teaching them a lot of knowledge. In Eileen's dream, he appears as an all-wise archer, leading them to victory.

3. New adventure chapters & core gameplay! Chapters 2 and 3 will be launched in the official version
Chapter 2: The Lost Castle, core gameplay - collect crystals to unlock and upgrade corresponding effects by opening the Crystal Book
Chapter 3: Midnight Shop, core gameplay - earn gold by buying and selling fixed items and purchase suitable strategic effects and potions, etc.

4. New adventure stories! Abyss & Challenge
In adventure mode, both the abyss - Nightmare and Challenge modes will be launched together. Please be prepared for the extreme spiciness.

5. Hidden plot? Art collection short stories are unlocked!
After passing the chapters and obtaining the corresponding puzzles to unlock the art collection, you can access the hidden plot. The story of the wonderland world unfolds from here.

P.S. Due to development time reasons, the Easy Mode of Chapter 3 is still being tested and modified, and will be updated in a timely manner through patches, which does not affect the early game experience. The Hard Mode and Abyss Mode of Chapter 3 will also be updated successively.
❤ Look forward to subsequent new version iterations, which will include new characters and content updates~

notes.title: "CARD QUEST" Officially Scheduled, Launching on Steam November 1st

At that time, adventurers are welcome to come and support! This will be a brand new adventure and experience, joining hands with the cat Ace to save his sister Eileen's dream

1.New character debut! Miracle Archer - Aller
Aller: The big brother of the orphanage, he has always taken care of Ace and Eileen, teaching them a lot of knowledge. In Eileen's dream, he appears as a wise and omnipotent archer, leading them to victory.

2.New adventure chapters & core gameplay! 3.New adventure stories! Abyss & Challenge In the adventure mode, the abyss - Nightmare and challenge mode in Chapter 2 & Chapter 3 will be launched together. Please be prepared for the extremely spicy challenge.

4.Hidden plot? Art collection short stories are open! After passing the chapters to get the corresponding puzzles to unlock the art collection, you can get the hidden plot. The story of the Wonderland World begins to unfold.

❤ Subsequent versions are ready to go; there will be new characters and content updates~
Everything is being optimized in an orderly manner, and the demo version has been added to the new product festival for free experience! The official price will have a surprise, maybe the most time-killing weapon this year. Please look forward to it!
